
* Includes 3 different demo scenes.
* Supports all Render Pipelines

NOTE ON MATERIALS: 
If everything appears pink in your scene, you can simply upgrade the materials 
to match your current active Render Pipeline. The materials only carry basic 
color data, so upgrading them will not break any functionality.

A. LoadScene      : Plays the transition and asynchronously loads a new scene.
B. PlayTransition : Plays the transition animation without changing the scene.

Both functions accept the following parameters:
- TransitionType type      : The visual effect to use (1 of 30 available types).
- float? enterDuration     : Duration of the screen closing phase (Optional).
- float? exitDuration      : Duration of the screen opening phase (Optional).
- Color? customColor       : Transition color (Optional, defaults to black).
- UnityAction onHalfway    : Callback triggered when the screen is fully closed (Optional).
- UnityAction onCompleted  : Callback triggered when the transition is fully finished (Optional).

EXAMPLE 1: Loading a Scene by Name
EasyPeasyTransition.Instance.LoadScene(
    "GameScene", 
    EasyPeasyTransition.TransitionType.Jaws
);


EXAMPLE 2: Loading a Scene by Build Index with Custom Duration
EasyPeasyTransition.Instance.LoadScene(
    1, 
    EasyPeasyTransition.TransitionType.PixelDissolve, 
    1.5f
);


EXAMPLE 3: Setting Separate Enter and Exit Durations with Custom Color
EasyPeasyTransition.Instance.LoadScene(
    "MainMenu", 
    EasyPeasyTransition.TransitionType.BouncingBars, 
    0.2f,  // Enter duration (closes fast)
    1.2f,  // Exit duration (opens slowly)
    Color.black
);


EXAMPLE 4: Using Callbacks (Events) During Scene Load
EasyPeasyTransition.Instance.LoadScene(
    "GameScene", 
    EasyPeasyTransition.TransitionType.SpiralGrid, 
    0.5f, 
    0.5f, 
    Color.black, 
    () => 
    {
        // Executed when the screen is completely covered.
        // Safe to reset player data or play a specific sound.
    }, 
    () => 
    {
        // Executed when the new scene is active and the opening animation ends.
    }
);


EXAMPLE 5: Playing an UI Animation Without Changing Scenes
EasyPeasyTransition.Instance.PlayTransition(
    EasyPeasyTransition.TransitionType.ClockWipe, 
    0.6f, 
    0.4f, 
    Color.black, 
    () => 
    {
        // Executed halfway through. Swap UI panels or teleport objects here.
        oldPanel.SetActive(false);
        newPanel.SetActive(true);
    }
);
